card.name: Lab supply names in radiochemical purity tests
card.fires_on: Pieces of catalog names and part numbers for lab supplies, such as Sep-Pak C18, Part #51910, and Whatman 31ET paper, in a Tc 99m mertiatide purity test. Weaker on 'air' before 'way' in airway.
